parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only mock cache implementations. Although their `set` methods share a near-duplicate shape (Jaccard 0.7), each mock is scoped to its own distinct test suite and domain concept (playcut metadata vs. Discogs entity resolution), making the structural similarity coincidental within the test-fixture context. Consolidating them would couple unrelated test suites and reduce test clarity without meaningful production benefit.
